requirements_summary: Primary workload: enterprise research search (RAG) combining dense embeddings + ML reranker to surface research notes and regulatory filings.
Scale target: index 20M+ documents over 12 months; baseline POC at 2M docs.
Latency targets: median <30ms for embedding lookup + rerank; p99 <= 100ms for professional users; soft 200ms for bulk analytics queries.
Throughput: steady-state 100 QPS during market hours; burst to 500 QPS for research events.
Cost sensitivity: target amortized cost per query <= $0.005, with clear levers for batching, caching, and quantized model variants.
Model preferences: open-models allowed; prefer quantized reranker variants validated for no-regression on research prompts.
Routing/fallback: want dedicated capacity primary with hosted fallback regionally isolated for DR; automatic fallback to smaller reranker if heavy load.
Security/compliance: must integrate with customer KMS (HSM-backed), SSO (SAML), audit logs forwarded to SIEM, and strict EU/US residency controls per dataset.
Operational: per-route telemetry, token-level cost breakdown, and eval hooks for regression detection tied to known prompt sets.
